    p = params
    lt = np.log(t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*lt + p[2]*t/(p[3]+t)
            + (p[4] + p[5]*lt + p[6]*t)*P**p[7]

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    lt = np.log(t)
    sP = np.sqrt(P)
    lP = np.log(P)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*lt + p[2]*t + p[3]*P + p[4]*P**2 + p[5]*sP
            + p[6]*P*lt + p[7]*P*lP + p[8]*t*P + p[9]*t*sP)
